tone.target: jangly indie crunch with airy chorus and roomy delay
tone.profile: jangly indie crunch with airy chorus and roomy delay
tone.summary: A clean signal chain utilizing a light overdrive for grit, followed by Chorus and an AC30 TB amp model with UK Vintage 4x12 cab, finished with Room reverb and Digital Delay for depth.

rig.name: Cage The Elephant - Shake Me Down - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide bright edge-of-breakup and slight grit without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: Green OD is a general choice for light breakup, mimicking the desired 'bright edge' effect.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive than Green OD but still suitable.

blocks.purpose: Add the required airy chorus texture for indie jangle.
Bypass or use for subtle texture if needed (kept off to maintain clean tone).
Simulate the Vox-style amp and bright, articulate tone.
blocks.gap: AC30 TB is the best fit for a classic British/Vox sound required by the genre clues.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if AC30 sounds too bright.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet sound suitable for indie rock.
Add a spacious, roomy depth to the mix.
Implement the required short, airy delay for depth and jangle.
Slightly boost the high end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall tonal depth by swapping the IR for a more open, airy British cab sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance jangly indie tone with an open, less boxy cabinet sound.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased air and clarity in the high end.
